This April, OpenAI launched an upgraded image generation technology named ChatGPT Images 2. Five months later, the company is now releasing an enhanced version, ChatGPT Images 2.5.

Compared with the company's previous image generation tools, ChatGPT Images 2 represented a major leap forward.

It introduced 2K resolution output, support for multiple aspect ratios, and the ability to retrieve the latest information through web searches. Images 2 also enhanced support for non-Latin language systems and offered two intelligence tiers: Instant and Thinking.

The new version, Images 2.5, focuses on "sharper details, faster generation speed, more precise editing, and more refined creation and sharing tools."

OpenAI stated: "Images 2.5 brings more natural lighting, richer textures, higher fidelity to subjects in reference images, and more reliably follows editing instructions across multiple rounds of conversation."

"Compared with Images 2.0, we have also reduced image generation latency by up to 50%, allowing you to generate images and refine your ideas more quickly."

In addition, the company detailed a brand-new "Sketch" feature that lets users draw directly within ChatGPT and use these drawings as references for image generation. OpenAI is also launching templates for popular image formats, as well as a prompt-sharing feature that allows others to try out your image generation ideas, along with other new functions.

Meanwhile, OpenAI is offering developers two versions of Images 2.5 to help them integrate related capabilities into applications. GPT-Image-2.5 Flare and GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst will be available through OpenAI's API:

GPT‑Image‑2.5 Flare brings the same quality, editing, and speed improvements to the API. This is the recommended choice for most applications, offering higher image quality than GPT‑Image‑2 with 50% lower latency. It is suitable for a wide range of use cases, from creator and social media content, product experiences, visual search, to rapid image prototyping and large-scale generation. GPT‑Image‑2.5 Sunburst is designed for high-end visual workflows that require more precise editing control, making it ideal for creative and editing workflows such as producing advertising assets or retouched product images.

OpenAI stated: "Images 2.5 will roll out starting today on desktop, mobile, and web versions, available to all tiers of ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex users." For more information about the new image generation technology, please visit here.

The launch of ChatGPT Images 2.5 follows last week's release of GPT-6 Astra.
